title: Tráfego por grupo de ASN/CDN
description: Banda por grupo de ASN/CDN (Google, Meta, Netflix, caches...). Grupos editáveis no painel web. Dados de tráfego no ClickHouse.

panels.title: Banda por grupo
panels.description: Taxa de cada grupo ao longo do tempo (só os grupos cadastrados; o resto fica em 'Outros' na tabela). Recebido = download dos clientes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(p.bucket_utc, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,coalesce(nullIf(arrayFirst(r -> IPv4StringToNumOrDefault(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN r.1 AND r.2, (SELECT groupArray((v_start, v_end, name)) FROM orby_net_prefixes WHERE kind='group')).3, ''), nullIf(g.name, ''), 'Outros') AS metric,SUM(p.total_bytes)*8/$__interval_s AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute p LEFT JOIN orby_asn_group_members g ON g.asn = p.${lado}_asn WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) AND NOT arrayExists(r -> IPv4StringToNumOrDefault(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN r.1 AND r.2, (SELECT groupArray((v_start, v_end)) FROM orby_net_prefixes WHERE kind IN ('protected','private','infra'))) GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING metric<>'Outros' ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(nullIf(arrayFirst(r -> IPv4StringToNumOrDefault(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN r.1 AND r.2, (SELECT groupArray((v_start, v_end, name)) FROM orby_net_prefixes WHERE kind='group')).3, ''), nullIf(g.name, ''), 'Outros') AS grupo,SUM(p.total_bytes) AS volume FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute p LEFT JOIN orby_asn_group_members g ON g.asn = p.${lado}_asn WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) AND NOT arrayExists(r -> IPv4StringToNumOrDefault(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN r.1 AND r.2, (SELECT groupArray((v_start, v_end)) FROM orby_net_prefixes WHERE kind IN ('protected','private','infra'))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT coalesce(nullIf(arrayFirst(r -> IPv4StringToNumOrDefault(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN r.1 AND r.2, (SELECT groupArray((v_start, v_end, name)) FROM orby_net_prefixes WHERE kind='group')).3, ''), nullIf(g.name, ''), 'Outros') AS "Grupo",SUM(p.total_bytes) AS "Volume",SUM(p.total_bytes)*8/greatest(1, dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AS "Taxa média",round(100 * sum(p.total_bytes) / greatest(1, sum(sum(p.total_bytes)) OVER ()), 1) AS "% do total",uniqExact(p.${lado}_ip) AS "IPs remotos" FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute p LEFT JOIN orby_asn_group_members g ON g.asn = p.${lado}_asn WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) AND NOT arrayExists(r -> IPv4StringToNumOrDefault(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN r.1 AND r.2, (SELECT groupArray((v_start, v_end)) FROM orby_net_prefixes WHERE kind IN ('protected','private','infra'))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Maiores ASNs fora dos grupos ('Outros')
panels.description: Candidatos a virar grupo: cadastre no painel web (Monitoramento > Grupos de ASN). Caches de CDN dentro do transito entram por bloco IP.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.${lado}_asn AS "ASN",anyIf(p.${lado}_asn_name, p.${lado}_asn_name != '') AS "Nome",SUM(p.total_bytes) AS "Volume",SUM(p.total_bytes)*8/greatest(1, dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AS "Taxa média",uniqExact(p.${lado}_ip) AS "IPs remotos" FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute p LEFT JOIN orby_asn_group_members g ON g.asn = p.${lado}_asn WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) AND NOT arrayExists(r -> IPv4StringToNumOrDefault(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN r.1 AND r.2, (SELECT groupArray((v_start, v_end)) FROM orby_net_prefixes WHERE kind IN ('protected','private','infra'))) AND coalesce(nullIf(arrayFirst(r -> IPv4StringToNumOrDefault(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN r.1 AND r.2, (SELECT groupArray((v_start, v_end, name)) FROM orby_net_prefixes WHERE kind='group')).3, ''), nullIf(g.name, ''), 'Outros')='Outros' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 30
